\cvrow{Research Experience}{\entry{\href{https://illinois.edu/}{University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign}}{Graduate research, Bryan K. Clark group}{Nov 2025--present}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Develop probabilistic and multimodal inference for crystal electric field inverse problems, with physics-based forward reconstruction of observables.
  \item Study robustness to experimental noise and simulation-to-experiment distribution shift in magnetic and scattering inverse problems.
  \item Implemented neural-network backflow wavefunctions and variational Monte Carlo for correlated fermions, with parallel cluster sampling and reuse of wavefunction evaluations.
\end{itemize}}{8}
\cvrow{}{\entry{\href{https://illinois.edu/}{University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign}}{Research assistant, Vidya Madhavan group}{Aug 2023--Oct 2025}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Grew thin-film heterostructures by molecular beam epitaxy and characterized materials with STM/STS in ultrahigh vacuum.
  \item Automated MBE temperature control with feedback, measurement logging, and alerts for repeatable growth protocols.
  \item Developed Python and MATLAB STM/STS analysis, including constant-energy contours and joint-density-of-states calculations for quasiparticle interference.
\end{itemize}}{15}
